posts.author: Public Health Communications
posts.title: Boil Water Advisory - North Basin Zone
posts.body: Sampling in the North Basin Zone detected E. coli. Residents must bring tap water to a rolling boil for one minute before drinking, preparing food, brushing teeth, making ice, or mixing infant formula. Continue these precautions until Public Health issues a clearance notice.

posts.author: Public Health Communications
posts.title: Water Quality Update - East Ridge
posts.body: Routine sampling is complete and no household precautions are needed. East Ridge residents may drink tap water normally and use it for food preparation, brushing teeth, ice, and infant formula.

posts.author: Public Health Communications
posts.title: West Harbor Water Advisory Lifted
posts.body: Two consecutive sample rounds met clearance criteria. West Harbor residents may resume normal tap-water use. Flush household cold-water taps for five minutes before first use.
